title: Plant Manager
text:
**Plant Manager**
=================

Ft.Wayne, IN, US, 46808-1998

Requisition: 68658

**Dana is a global leader in the supply of highly engineered driveline, sealing, and thermal-management technologies that improve the efficiency and performance of vehicles with both conventional and alternative-energy powertrains. Serving two primary markets – passenger vehicle and commercial truck equipment – Dana provides the world's original-equipment manufacturers and the aftermarket with local product and service support through a network of nearly 100 engineering, manufacturing, and distribution facilities.**

**Job Purpose**
---------------

The Plant Manager (PM) must effectively organize, lead & manage all functional elements of the facility. The PM must embrace corporate & business unit initiatives including lean manufacturing & implementation of the Dana Operating System (based on the Toyota Production System (TPS)). The PM will maintain a workforce for highly motivated employees with a morale that is conducive with performance being measured at or above minimum acceptable levels, drive performance to achieve or exceed financial plans & strategic goals. The PM operates within the overall framework of Dana strategies, set objectives, & procedures.

**Job Duties and Responsibilities**
-----------------------------------

* Full plant P&L responsibility including strategy, policies, processes, practices, systems.
* Provide leadership & management of people, processes, & products including, but not limited to:
 
 - Manufacturing &/or assembly operations
 
 - Sales; finance (operating budget, cost controls, capital management, AP/AR etc.)
 
 - Supply chain management (procurement/distribution)
 
 - Inventory management
 
 - Environmental/occupational health & safety
 
 - Employee selection & development
 
 - Labor relations
 
 - Continuous improvement (cost, quality, productivity, operational excellence)
 
 - Metrics & reporting
 
 - Program management
 
 - Product launches
 
 - Facilities & equipment, & engineering
* Communicate successfully at all levels within the organization as well as externally with customers, suppliers & the community.
* Establish credibility (through Lean knowledge, business acumen, & plant-specific knowledge) with business unit & other executive leadership to influence basic strategy & effective inclusion of long-range improvements to business unit plans.

**Education and Qualifications**
--------------------------------

* *Bachelor’s degree or 4+ years of applicable experience*
* *12+ years of experience*

**Skills**
----------

* Ability to set and execute long-term operational strategies that align with business goals, including production efficiency, cost control, and quality improvement.
* Deep understanding of manufacturing systems, lean principles, and continuous improvement methodologies to drive performance across all plant functions.
* Strong grasp of budgeting, cost analysis, and financial metrics to manage plant profitability and resource allocation effectively.
* Proven ability to lead, motivate, and develop diverse teams, fostering a culture of accountability, safety, and engagement.
* Excellent communication skills to coordinate with departments such as engineering, quality, supply chain, and corporate leadership, ensuring alignment and transparency.
* Experience working in an unionized work environment.
